edges.reason: msg.sender is read as the caller inside ContextMixin.msgSender
_msgSender forwards to ContextMixin.msgSender()
_msgSender ultimately derives its value from msg.sender
msgSender falls back to an assembly read of msg.data to recover the sender on self-calls
assembly-derived address becomes the returned sender and can be spoofed by meta-transaction calldata
mint uses the only(PREDICATE_ROLE) modifier which evaluates hasRole(role,_msgSender())
PREDICATE_ROLE is the role required to enter mint
role membership is read from _roles during the only modifier check
mint calls the internal _mint
user address is forwarded from mint into _mint
amount is forwarded from mint into _mint
account parameter of _mint receives the minted-to address
amount flows into _balances[account] through SafeMath.add
_mint writes the increased balance into _balances
_mint increases _totalSupply by amount via SafeMath.add
verify uses toTypedMessageHash which reads domainSeperator
executeMetaTransaction calls verify to validate the signature
the constructed metaTx struct is passed into verify
verify hashes the metaTx through hashMetaTransaction
userAddress builds the metaTx struct and is appended to the low-level calldata
attacker-controlled functionSignature is used to construct the executed self-call data
nonces[userAddress] is read to build the metaTx struct
nonces[userAddress] is incremented with SafeMath.add(1) for replay protection
executeMetaTransaction performs a low-level call to address(this)
functionSignature bytes are appended and executed by the low-level call
userAddress is appended to the calldata and becomes msg.sender inside the re-entrant frame
the external low-level call re-enters the contract before surrounding state effects settle
the re-entrant self-call can dispatch into mint if the appended address holds PREDICATE_ROLE
msg.sender is used as the relayer address in the MetaTransactionExecuted event
grantRole requires the caller to hold the admin role of the target role
_msgSender is passed into hasRole inside grantRole
_roles[role].adminRole is read to authorize grantRole
revokeRole requires the caller to hold the admin role of the target role
_msgSender is passed into hasRole inside revokeRole
_roles[role].adminRole is read to authorize revokeRole
transfer uses _msgSender() as the sending account
transfer delegates balance movement to _transfer
transferFrom delegates balance movement to _transfer
transferFrom uses _msgSender() as the allowance spender
_transfer updates _balances with SafeMath sub and add
transferFrom subtracts the spent amount from _allowances via SafeMath.sub
transferFrom calls _approve to write the reduced allowance
_approve writes the new value into _allowances
constructor calls _setupRole with DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE
constructor calls _setupRole with PREDICATE_ROLE
constructor grants both roles to _msgSender()
constructor mints 1000000000 * 10**18 tokens through _mint
name_ parameter is forwarded to the ERC20 constructor and _initializeEIP712
symbol_ parameter is forwarded to the ERC20 constructor
constructor initializes the EIP712 domain
_initializeEIP712 sets domainSeperator through _setDomainSeperator
the initializer modifier toggles inited to prevent re-initialization
recipient address receives value through the low-level call in sendValue
target address of the low-level call is a caller-influenced parameter
weiValue is forwarded as msg.value into the low-level call
sender local variable is returned by ContextMixin.msgSender

normalization_plan.reason: user address parameter only feeds the internal _mint balance update
amount parameter only feeds the internal _mint arithmetic
userAddress parameter only feeds metaTx construction and calldata appending in executeMetaTransaction
functionSignature parameter only feeds the low-level self-call inside executeMetaTransaction
MetaTransaction memory struct is a temporary local used only for verification
account parameter of _mint only feeds the balance and supply updates
name_ constructor parameter only feeds ERC20 setup and EIP712 domain naming
symbol_ constructor parameter only feeds ERC20 symbol setup
sender local variable is the return value produced by ContextMixin.msgSender
recipient parameter is the destination of the low-level value call in Address.sendValue
target parameter is the callee of the low-level call in Address._functionCallWithValue
weiValue parameter is the msg.value forwarded in Address._functionCallWithValue
